limitations: The v2.1 snapshot quarantines every member of 87 mixed-condition connected components (293 rows), including PLDD-UP conflicts. This removes contradictory supervision but is not expert label adjudication and does not establish that the retained labels are correct.

Potato condition supervision is dominated by PLDD-UP operational-field images from Uttar Pradesh, India; it is not evidence of performance in Nepal or across Nepal's varieties, altitudes, seasons, devices, and field backgrounds.

Digital Green has already been inspected and used during model iteration, so its India-heavy external split is a development diagnostic rather than an unbiased final holdout and must not be used to make final promotion claims.
Filename and perceptual grouping reduce known leakage, but source metadata cannot prove independence at the farm, plant, or capture-session level.

Only early blight, late blight, and healthy are supervised as provisional known labels; all other potato diseases, pests, deficiencies, mixed symptoms, and unsuitable views must be treated as unknown or refused.
No independently labelled and locked Nepal test set exists, and no candidate may be promoted until one passes preregistered crop-, condition-, refusal-, and calibration gates.

The manifest has no admitted manually reviewed non-plant negatives; staged Open Images candidates remain ineligible until rights, attribution, relevance, and labels are reviewed. Non-plant refusal performance is therefore unestablished.
